title: Electronic Gradebook

accessDeniedBody: Journals are open to the course mentor and to administrators. Return to Journals to choose a course you can open.

conflict.entryUnavailableBody: This lesson entry no longer exists on the server. Refetch to check again, or discard your change.

table.noStudentsInCourse: There are no students in this course

drain.title: Leaving this page
drain.savingBody: Saving your changes before you leave…
drain.failedBody: Your changes are still on this page. Retry saving, review them, or stay.
drain.conflictBody: Some changes conflict with newer data on the server. Review them before leaving.
drain.unavailableBody: Saving is not possible right now. Check your connection and try again.
drain.discardFailed: Could not discard right now. Check your connection and try again.

hub.searchScopeNotice: Search covers only the journals loaded on this page, not the whole catalog.
hub.refreshFailed: Could not refresh journals. Showing the last loaded list.

emptyCatalog.title: No journals yet
emptyCatalog.body: A journal appears here for every course you are permitted to open. When a course is added or assigned to you, its journal will be listed.

noMatch.title: No journals match
noMatch.body: Nothing on this page matches your search or status filter. Clear them to see every journal loaded for this page.

notice.period: That period is not part of this course. Showing {{period}} instead.

workspace.readOnlyArchived: This course is archived, so its journal is read-only.
workspace.forbidden: You no longer have permission to edit this journal. Your unsaved changes are kept here for review and are not being sent.
workspace.draftsKept: Your unsaved changes are kept on this page.
workspace.periodsLoadFailed: Could not load the journal periods
workspace.noPeriodsBody: Periods are created for each week or month of the course. This course has none yet, so there is nothing to grade.

grid.scrollHint: Scroll sideways to see more lessons
grid.refreshFailed: Could not refresh the journal. Showing the last loaded data.
grid.noLessonsBody: Lessons appear here when the course schedule has lessons in this period. Summary is still available.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.grade: Set the score and move down
help.scope: Shortcuts work when a cell is focused, not while typing in a field.
help.scoreRule: Scores 1–5 mark the student present. Marking absent resets the lesson score.

lesson.heading: Lesson roster, {{period}}
lesson.errorLine: This change was not saved. Use Retry in the status line.
lesson.conflictLine: This change conflicts with newer data. Use Review in the status line.

comment.title: Comment for {{name}}, {{date}}
comment.cancelConsequence: Cancel discards your unsaved comment changes.

search.label: Search students in this period
search.noMatchBody: Nobody in this period's roster matches “{{query}}”. Clear the search to see everyone.

progress.refreshFailed: Could not refresh progress. Showing the last loaded results.
progress.noPeriodsBody: Results appear here once the course has journal periods.

chart.label: Percentage by period
chart.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to move between periods.

progress.noStartedBody: Results appear here once the first period starts.

atRisk.label: At risk
